result.description: TELECOMM GEEKS PTY LTD   Duties :    Examine technical drawings, specifications, and work sites to determine cable routes, equipment locations, and installation requirements.  Install, terminate, and test structured cabling systems for voice, data, NBN, CCTV, security, and telecommunications networks.  Install, splice, terminate and test fibre optic networks including FTTP, FTTC and business fibre services.  Install telecommunications cabling for telephone, radio, pay TV, fibre optic, and computer transmission systems.  Install and commission telecommunications equipment, including data outlets, patch panels, switchboards, network racks, and communication devices.  Locate and diagnose faults in telecommunications cabling and equipment using specialised electronic testing instruments.  Repair, replace, adjust, and maintain faulty telecommunications equipment and cabling.  Join, terminate, and seal copper and fibre optic cables using approved industry methods.  Install, test, and maintain aerial and underground telecommunications cables and associated infrastructure.  Connect wires and cables to telecommunications equipment and ensure all connections are accurately labelled and tested.  Perform system testing, commissioning, and fault rectification to ensure reliable network performance.  Complete installation reports, testing documentation, and maintenance records.  Ensure all work complies with Australian Standards, telecommunications regulations, and workplace health and safety requirements.   Requirements:   Certificate III or Certificate IV in Telecommunications, Cabling, or a related field.  At least 1 year of relevant full-time experience as a Telecommunications Cabler or in a similar role.  Experience in installing, terminating, testing, and maintaining structured cabling systems, including copper and fibre optic networks.  Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, and telecommunications specifications.  Experience using cable testing and fault-finding equipment to diagnose and rectify telecommunications faults.  Current Open Cabling Registration (or the ability to obtain it prior to commencement).  Good understanding of Australian telecommunications standards and workplace health and safety requirements.  Strong problem-solving, communication, and organisational skills.  Ability to work independently and as part of a team.  Current driver's licence.   Benefits   Competitive salary package plus superannuation.  Full-time, permanent position with long-term career opportunities.  Opportunity to work on a variety of commercial and residential telecommunications projects.  Ongoing training and professional development to enhance your technical skills.  Supportive and collaborative team environment.  Modern tools, equipment, and resources provided.  Opportunities for career progression within a growing company.  Safe workplace with a strong commitment to Work Health and Safety (WHS).  Stable workload with consistent full-time hours.  Work with an experienced team delivering high-quality telecommunications solutions.   About Company    TELECOMM GEEKS PTY LTD T/A Telco Geeks is a locally owned and operated telecommunications company with a strong presence across the Perth metropolitan and surrounding regions. We are committed to delivering high-quality, reliable, and innovative telecommunications solutions to meet the evolving needs of both commercial and residential clients. Our experienced team specialises in civil telecommunications works, fibre optic installation and splicing, copper jointing, structured cabling, network construction, fault diagnosis, maintenance, and infrastructure upgrades. We pride ourselves on delivering projects safely, efficiently, and to the highest industry standards while maintaining a strong focus on customer satisfaction. Through our commitment to quality workmanship, technical excellence, and continuous improvement, Telco Geeks has established a reputation as a trusted telecommunications service provider supporting Australia's growing communications infrastructure.
